summary: An aluminium-silicon braze-cladding option listed by Gränges for controlled-atmosphere brazing of rolled heat-exchanger products.
guidance: Treat this as a clad-layer material, with core alloy, layer ratio and brazing cycle specified separately. The brochure lists iron variants and permits zinc modification; this entry retains only the shared silicon interval.
scope: Selected clad-layer chemistry only; no clad temper, standalone mechanical data or complete composition established.
